numeric_evidence.sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY s.total_exec_time DESC,s.queryid) AS ordinal,s.queryid::text AS queryid,r.rolname AS role_name,s.calls,round(s.mean_exec_time::numeric,3) AS mean_ms,round(s.total_exec_time::numeric,1) AS total_ms,round(s.max_exec_time::numeric,1) AS max_ms,s.shared_blks_hit,s.shared_blks_read,s.temp_blks_written,s.temp_blks_read,s.rows,CASE WHEN ltrim(s.query) ILIKE 'WITH%' THEN 'WITH' WHEN ltrim(s.query) ILIKE 'SELECT%' THEN 'SELECT' WHEN ltrim(s.query) ILIKE 'INSERT%' THEN 'INSERT' WHEN ltrim(s.query) ILIKE 'UPDATE%' THEN 'UPDATE' WHEN ltrim(s.query) ILIKE 'DELETE%' THEN 'DELETE' ELSE 'OTHER' END AS kind,lower((regexp_match(s.query,'dic_[a-z0-9_]+','i'))[1]) AS dic_identifier FROM pg_stat_statements s LEFT JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid=s.userid WHERE s.calls>0), selected AS (SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE ordinal BETWEEN 161 AND 240) SELECT jsonb_build_object('observed_at',now(),'stats_reset',(SELECT stats_reset FROM pg_stat_statements_info),'total_active_fingerprints',(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_statements WHERE calls>0),'selected',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(selected) ORDER BY ordinal) FROM selected)) AS evidence

full_definitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION extensions.pgrst_ddl_watch()
 RETURNS event_trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  cmd record;
BEGIN
  FOR cmd IN SELECT * FROM pg_event_trigger_ddl_commands()
  LOOP
    IF cmd.command_tag IN (
      'CREATE SCHEMA', 'ALTER SCHEMA'
    , 'CREATE TABLE', 'CREATE TABLE AS', 'SELECT INTO', 'ALTER TABLE'
    , 'CREATE FOREIGN TABLE', 'ALTER FOREIGN TABLE'
    , 'CREATE VIEW', 'ALTER VIEW'
    , 'CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW', 'ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW'
    , 'CREATE FUNCTION', 'ALTER FUNCTION'
    , 'CREATE TRIGGER'
    , 'CREATE TYPE', 'ALTER TYPE'
    , 'CREATE RULE'
    , 'COMMENT'
    )
    -- don't notify in case of CREATE TEMP table or other objects created on pg_temp
    AND cmd.schema_name is distinct from 'pg_temp'
    THEN
      NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
END; $function$

full_definitions.name: pgrst_drop_watch
full_definitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION extensions.pgrst_drop_watch()
 RETURNS event_trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  obj record;
BEGIN
  FOR obj IN SELECT * FROM pg_event_trigger_dropped_objects()
  LOOP
    IF obj.object_type IN (
      'schema'
    , 'table'
    , 'foreign table'
    , 'view'
    , 'materialized view'
    , 'function'
    , 'trigger'
    , 'type'
    , 'rule'
    )
    AND obj.is_temporary IS false -- no pg_temp objects
    THEN
      NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
END; $function$

semantic_per_hook.ensure_rls: Provider creates public-table RLS on CREATE TABLE/AS/SELECT INTO; logs and catches ALTER errors, therefore best-effort, not a guaranteed fail-closed guard.
semantic_per_hook.issue_graphql_placeholder: Provider DROP EXTENSION hook installs a graphql_public not-enabled stub; retain platform behavior.
semantic_per_hook.issue_pg_cron_access: Provider CREATE EXTENSION pg_cron privilege setup, restricted postgres cron.job access; not safely removable.
semantic_per_hook.issue_pg_graphql_access: Provider extension DDL graphql wrapper grants; catalog not effective hosted GraphQL endpoint proof.
semantic_per_hook.issue_pg_net_access: Provider conditional version-aware pg_net privileges; no observed evidence of active outbound calls.
